en.Кинематика описывает движение без причин: Kinematics describes motion without its causes (forces and masses). Basic concepts:
en.Движение — изменение положения тела со в: Motion is the change of a body's position with time relative to a reference frame. Trajectory is the line of motion, a point mass is a point that has mass.
en.Путь s — длина траектории (скаляр, метр): Distance s is the length of the trajectory (a scalar, metre). Displacement Δr = rB − rA is a vector. They are equal in magnitude only for straight-line motion in one direction; on returning to the start Δr = 0, but s ≠ 0.
en.Скорость: средняя путевая vср = Δs/Δt (с: Velocity: average speed v<sub>avg</sub> = Δs/Δt (a scalar) and average vector velocity v⃗<sub>avg</sub> = Δr⃗/Δt are different quantities. Instantaneous velocity is the limit as Δt → 0; its magnitude equals the instantaneous speed.
en.v = −gt, y = y₀ − ½gt², g ≈ 9,81 м/с² (б: v = −gt, y = y₀ − ½gt², g ≈ 9.81 m/s² (no air resistance)
en.Графики: для равномерного x(t) — прямая,: Graphs: for uniform motion x(t) is a straight line and v(t) is horizontal; for uniformly accelerated motion x(t) is a parabola and v(t) is a sloped line. Displacement equals the area under the v(t) graph (signed), acceleration is the slope of v(t). This is how 1.17–1.18 are solved.
en.Независимость движений: по x и y движени: Independence of motions: along x and y the motions occur independently; along x — uniform, along y — with acceleration −g.
en.Горизонтальный бросок: vx = v₀, vy = −gt: Horizontal projectile: v<sub>x</sub> = v₀, v<sub>y</sub> = −gt, x = v₀t, y = y₀ − ½gt².
en.Бросок под углом α: v₀ₓ = v₀ cos α, v₀ᵧ: Projectile at angle α: v₀ₓ = v₀ cos α, v₀ᵧ = v₀ sin α, v<sub>y</sub> = v₀ sin α − gt. The velocity is tangent to the trajectory: v = √(v<sub>x</sub>² + v<sub>y</sub>²), tan β = v<sub>y</sub>/v<sub>x</sub>.
en.Дальность — подставить y = 0 в y(t), най: Range — substitute y = 0 in y(t), find the flight time, substitute it in x(t).
en.Описание движения зависит от системы отс: The description of motion depends on the reference frame. Two trains with velocities v⃗₁ and v⃗₂ relative to the ground: the velocity of the second relative to the first

en.Динамика объясняет причины движения: дей: Dynamics explains the causes of motion: the action of forces. This is the basis for problems 2.4–2.17.
en.I закон (инерции): если сумма сил равна: First law (inertia): if the sum of forces is zero, a body is at rest or moves uniformly in a straight line (in an inertial reference frame).
en.II закон: ускорение пропорционально равн: Second law: acceleration is proportional to the net force and inversely proportional to the mass.
en.III закон: силы взаимодействия двух тел: Third law: the interaction forces of two bodies are equal in magnitude, opposite in direction, and applied to different bodies.
en.Единица силы: 1 Н = 1 кг·м/с². Метод реш: Unit of force: 1 N = 1 kg·m/s². Solution method: draw the body, mark all forces (weight mg, normal force N, tension T, friction, external), choose axes (along the motion), write the second law along the axes, solve the system. Massless pulley and string: the tension is the same on both sides, and the accelerations of connected bodies are equal in magnitude.
en.Трение покоя Ts ≤ fsN — подстраивается п: Static friction T<sub>s</sub> ≤ f<sub>s</sub>N — adjusts to the applied force up to the maximum f<sub>s</sub>N.
en.Трение скольжения Tk = fkN направлено пр: Kinetic friction T<sub>k</sub> = f<sub>k</sub>N is directed against the motion, usually f<sub>k</sub> < f<sub>s</sub>.
en.N — не всегда mg: на наклоне N = mg cos: N is not always mg: on an incline N = mg cos α, with a force at an angle N = mg ∓ F sin α.
en.Тело начинает скользить при tg αgr = fs: A body starts to slide when tan α<sub>crit</sub> = f<sub>s</sub> (critical angle). For uniform sliding tan α = f<sub>k</sub>. (Problems 2.11, 2.12, 2.14, 2.15.)
en.Угловая скорость ω = Δφ/Δt (рад/с), пери: Angular velocity ω = Δφ/Δt (rad/s), period T = 2π/ω, frequency f = 1/T = ω/2π.
en.Модуль скорости постоянен, но направлени: The speed is constant but the direction changes, so there is a centripetal acceleration directed toward the center.
en.Сила Fd — не новая сила, а равнодействую: The force F<sub>c</sub> is not a new force but the resultant of real forces (tension, friction, gravitation), directed toward the center.
en.Второй закон в «импульсной» форме верен: The second law in "momentum" form is valid for variable mass as well; the total momentum of a closed system is conserved (developed in later lectures).
en.Пример. Наклон 20°, fk = 0,3: a = 9,81(s: Example. Incline 20°, fk = 0.3: a = 9.81(sin 20° − 0.3 cos 20°) = 0.59 m/s² — problem 2.11d.
en.Внутренние силы системы не меняют её сум: Internal forces of a system do not change its total momentum (whatever their nature); only external forces can change it: Δp<sub>sys</sub> = F<sub>ext</sub>Δt.
en.Закон сохранения импульса: если равнодей: Law of conservation of momentum: if the net external force is zero, the momentum of the system is constant.
en.Работа — способ передачи энергии (не сам: Work is a way of transferring energy (not energy itself). For a constant force and displacement Δr:
en.W > 0 — телу передаётся энергия (0° ≤ α: W > 0 — energy is transferred to the body (0° ≤ α < 90°), W < 0 — energy is taken away (90° < α ≤ 180°). The work of an external force equals the change in mechanical energy: W<sub>ext</sub> = ΔE<sub>mech</sub>.
en.Работа равнодействующей равна изменению: The work of the net force equals the change in kinetic energy: W = ΔE<sub>k</sub> = ½mv<sub>k</sub>² − ½mv₀² (work–energy theorem).
en.Чтобы медленно поднять груз с h₀ до hk,: To raise a load slowly from h₀ to h<sub>k</sub>, the force F = mg is needed: W = mgh<sub>k</sub> − mgh₀ = ΔE<sub>p</sub>. The zero level of E<sub>p</sub> is chosen arbitrarily.
en.Сила упругости F = −kΔx (k — жёсткость п: Elastic force F = −kΔx (k is the spring constant). The force stretching a spring grows linearly, so W = ½kΔx² = ΔE<sub>p,spr</sub> (Δx is measured from the relaxed spring).
en.Консервативные силы (тяжесть, упругость): Conservative forces (gravity, elasticity) — the work does not depend on the path, and over a closed path it is 0; they depend only on position; W = −ΔEp. Friction and drag are non-conservative.
en.Если внешние силы не совершают работы и: If external forces do no work and internal forces are conservative, mechanical energy is constant: E<sub>mech</sub> = E<sub>k</sub> + E<sub>p</sub> = const.
en.При неконсервативных силах: WN = ΔU (изм: With non-conservative forces: W<sub>N</sub> = ΔU (change in internal energy), and the total energy E = E<sub>k</sub> + E<sub>p</sub> + U = const.
en.Столкновение — взаимодействие за конечно: A collision is an interaction over a finite time during which external forces are negligibly small. Momentum is always conserved.
en.Упругое — сохраняется и кинетическая эне: Elastic — kinetic energy is conserved as well. Inelastic — kinetic energy is not conserved; perfectly inelastic — the bodies stick together.
en.Центральное упругое столкновение: из зак: Central elastic collision: from the conservation of momentum and energy we get
en.Инерциальная система отсчёта — такая, гд: An inertial reference frame is one in which a body with no external influences moves without acceleration (Newton's first law). In non-inertial frames, inertial forces appear (the topic continues in the next lecture).
en.Пример. Шар m₁ налетает с u₁ на покоящий: Example. A ball m₁ hits a stationary m₂ = m₁ with u₁ (elastically): v₁ = 0, v₂ = u₁ — the balls exchange velocities.
